title: ML-momentum: bias-corrected multi-factor cross-sectional portfolio (Sharpe >2.0)
flagged_reason: HIGH RISK: requires point-in-time bias-free data (not available); Chinese A-share paper may not transfer to US; 500-1000 factors on small universe = severe overfitting risk; 40h implementation. Requires Kevin review before queuing.
summary: arXiv 2507.07107 reports 20% annualized returns, Sharpe >2.0 on Chinese A-shares using elastic-net over 500-1000 factors (alpha101 extensions + microstructure). Key innovations applicable to H158 (sector-neutral stock momentum): (1) tensor-based factor computation, (2) GBM data augmentation to reduce overfitting, (3) cross-sectional neutralization. Framework is Chinese-market focused but techniques transfer.

source.paper: Machine Learning Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading: A Cross-Sectional Portfolio Optimization Approach with Bias Correction
source.key_finding: 20% annualized, Sharpe >2.0 (2021-2024 backtest on A-shares). LTR methods ~3x higher Sharpe than traditional cross-sectional momentum

implementation.precondition: H158 sector-neutral stock momentum needs bias-free universe first
factor_sources: Custom microstructure: bid-ask spread, intraday vol, after-hours returns
implementation.model: LightGBM with rank-based cross-sectional neutralization + GBM data augmentation
implementation.requires: Point-in-time constituent data (Compustat/CRSP) — not currently available. Alternative: survivorship-biased NASDAQ universe with caveat.

risks: Chinese market dynamics differ significantly from US equities
500-1000 factors on small universe = severe overfitting risk without survivorship-bias-free data
High implementation complexity — should not be attempted before H158 simple version is confirmed
GBM data augmentation adds synthetic training samples that may not represent US market regimes
recommendation: Long-term queue. Unlock after: (1) H158 deferred status resolved with bias-free data source, (2) simpler ML approaches (elastic-net SUE from proposal #2) validated first.
